- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Applique work involves sewing colored cloth onto a larger piece to create designs.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Terracotta art involves creating sculptures from clay that has been fired.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Chhau dance is a traditional dance form involving elaborate masks and costumes.
